description: This file implements the AzureTableGrainDirectory class for Orleans, managing grain directory entries stored in Azure Table Storage. It includes methods for lookup, registration, unregistration, and lifecycle management of grain addresses.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implements the IGrainDirectory interface for Azure Table Storage, providing methods for grain address lookup, registration, and unregistration, along with lifecycle participation.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryEntity
classes.description: Represents a grain directory entry stored in Azure Table Storage, including conversion methods to and from GrainAddress objects.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain address by GrainId in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new grain address, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from storage.

methods.name: UnregisterMany
methods.description: Removes multiple grain addresses, batching if necessary.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Stub method for unregistering silos, not implemented due to cost.

methods.name: InitializeIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the table if it hasn't been initialized yet.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the directory to lifecycle events.

methods.name: UnregisterManyBlock
methods.description: Helper method to unregister a batch of grain addresses.
